summary: Phase 0 foundation and review hygiene complete. Configured pinned dependencies in version catalog, applied KSP with Room, SQLCipher, Biometric, and DataStore. Established single-module manual DI architecture. Enforced offline security hygiene: removed INTERNET permission via manifest merger, set android:allowBackup="false" with full data extraction exclusions, lowered minSdk to 24 with adaptive icon backward compatibility, and configured Git/review exclusions. Installed project-local skill at .agents/skills/password-keeper-android/SKILL.md. Implemented robust atomic snapshot replacement (System.IO.File.Replace), typed/untyped Kotlin secret redaction, and verified all real I/O failure and preservation paths using an automated fixture suite.
